references.relevant_content_paraphrase: The abstract distinguishes general filtering from the usual statistical decomposition into means and fluctuations: arbitrary filters need not satisfy Reynolds averaging rules. It presents an operator approach using generalized central moments and relationships between filtering levels.

references.supported_use: Primary context for distinguishing finite spatial filtering from Reynolds averaging and for full filtered central moments. The source-specific plasma momentum derivation and synthetic witnesses remain this study own bounded checks.
